name: io.github.andypgray/resharper-cli-mcp
description: ReSharper CLI inspection/cleanup via MCP. Unofficial: not affiliated with or endorsed by JetBrains.

environmentVariables.name: JB_SOLUTION_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Solution to analyse when the working directory holds zero or several. The solutionPath tool argument overrides it for one call.

environmentVariables.name: JB_SETTINGS_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Explicit .DotSettings file for jb, mounted as a Custom layer above the solution's and every project's own settings.

environmentVariables.name: JB_EXTENSIONS
environmentVariables.description: Semicolon-separated ReSharper plugin IDs to load.

environmentVariables.name: JB_EXTENSION_SOURCE
environmentVariables.description: Custom NuGet source for those ReSharper plugins.

environmentVariables.name: RESHARPER_MCP_TIMEOUT_SECS
environmentVariables.description: Cap in seconds on one jb run, and on the wait for one already in flight. Defaults to 600, clamped to 60-86,400.

environmentVariables.name: RESHARPER_MCP_PREWARM
environmentVariables.description: Set to off to stop the background cache pre-warm that runs when a client connects.

environmentVariables.name: RESHARPER_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Minimum level for the rolling file log. Defaults to Warning.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_MCP_OUTPUT_TOKENS
environmentVariables.description: Output budget the response is rendered to fit. Set by the MCP client rather than by hand; 25,000 characters when unset.
